plugin.name: WB Login Logout Redirect
plugin.requires: WordPress 6.5+, PHP 8.1+. Optional integrations: BuddyPress, BuddyBoss, WooCommerce, bbPress, Dokan, LearnDash, PeepSo.

ajax.purpose: Save settings for any scope (global, roles, integration) — parses a serialized form payload, sanitizes per-scope, writes the matching option.

admin_pages.title: Login Redirect
admin_pages.note: Card-panel admin added in 2.3.0 (replaces the legacy admin/wbcom wrapper). Integration tabs are added dynamically by the registry for active integrations that expose group types (e.g. BuddyPress member types). Settings save via the custom AJAX handler, not options.php.

hooks_fired.name: wbcom_redirect_honor_redirect_to
hooks_fired.purpose: Return true to let a requested same-site redirect_to win over the configured login redirect (default false).

hooks_consumed.name: woocommerce_login_redirect
hooks_consumed.purpose: Apply the resolved login redirect to the WooCommerce My Account login form.

hooks_consumed.name: allowed_redirect_hosts
hooks_consumed.purpose: Allow the host of a plugin-resolved destination for that one redirect (never the visitor redirect_to).

hooks_consumed.name: init
hooks_consumed.purpose: One-time 2.0.x settings migration; runs on any request so a member's first login after update keeps the old rules.

hooks_consumed.name: admin_notices
hooks_consumed.purpose: Warn users with update_plugins when vendor/easy-digital-downloads is missing (only hooked then).

integrations.framework: integrations/class-wbcom-redirect-integration*.php + a registry (Wbcom_Redirect_Integration_Registry::instance()). Each integration provides destinations and optional group-type admin tabs.
integrations.loaded: Each integration file is required on load if present; integrations self-register with the registry.
integrations.notes_2_3_0: BuddyPress activity/groups destinations resolve only while the component is active; page rules need a published page; Dokan destinations vendors only (dokan_is_user_seller); LearnDash dashboard offered only when a published 'dashboard' page exists; bbPress forums uses bbp_get_forums_url() only.

edd_license.client: Official EDD Software Licensing SDK (vendor/easy-digital-downloads/edd-sl-sdk, git submodule from vapvarun/edd-sl-sdk)
edd_license.model: Free auto-updates with a preset key — no user-facing license-key field. The License tab surfaces update status only.
edd_license.policy: KEEP the SDK — do NOT replace with the Contact Me custom client (it would be a downgrade). See portfolio memory feedback_edd_sdk_keep_when_present.

admin_ui.class: Wbcom_Redirect_Admin (admin/class-wbcom-redirect-admin.php) — single class: chrome + tab renderers + AJAX save
admin_ui.shell: render_settings_page() + render_tabs() emit the card-panel shell (header + sidebar nav + main slot); content rendered via add_settings_section/do_settings_sections.
admin_ui.assets: assets/css/admin.css (shell, --wbredir-admin-* tokens) + assets/css/wbcom-redirect-content.css (relocated from the former admin/wbcom wrapper, styles the tab content) + admin/assets/css/bp-redirect-admin.css + admin/assets/js/wbcom-redirect-admin.js (AJAX save, jQuery-UI accordion, toggle/radio show-hide).
admin_ui.settings_save: Custom AJAX (wbcom_redirect_save_settings) — NOT the Settings API. The card-panel form posts to the same handler.

vendor_tooling.reason: composer WPCS/lint tooling, untracked and not gitignored — stage migration files explicitly, never git add -A.
